title: Huge glowing craft over the November 5 missile site
place_text: November 5 missile site, Ellsworth AFB, South Dakota

tellings.quote: The diameter of that thing was so big that it actually exceeded the perimeters of the fence line.

plain: A US Air Force veteran named Mario Woods says that in November 1977 a huge glowing craft appeared over a nuclear missile site called November 5, which belonged to Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota. He says it was so wide that it stretched past the fence line around the site, and he names a fellow airman, Michael Johnson, as part of the story. If true, it would mean an unknown craft hovered over American nuclear weapons.
